title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – January 25, 2019
raw_text: January 28, 2019 Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – January 25, 2019 A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES General Fixed a bug that prevented some players from receiving the Captured and Delivery Interruption reward sprays after completing the achievement requirements Developer Comments: Players who have successfully earned the achievement will receive the reward sprays immediately next time they log in. [CHINA] Fixed a bug that prevented some players from receiving the Captured and Delivery Interruption reward sprays after completing the achievement requirements
